claim_summary: Plan ARIA-V3.2 — Runtime-Defect Closure post-V4 fresh-run audit. 10-agent parallel audit on commit 5b88522a surfaced 3 runtime defects + 1 deferred shadow-tree issue. D1: belief evidence freshness — multiple write paths to beliefs.jsonl (_record_belief / _apply_diff_to_existing_beliefs / _mark_quarantined_source_beliefs) with only the support path stamping freshness fields. D2: daily-report 'Total governance events' reads from shadow aria-kernel/aria-tools/ tree due to tool_registry.tools_dir CWD-relative fallback. D3: discovery_dirty_tree_skipped governance event missing cycle_id in details. D4 (DEFERRED to V3.3): full tools_dir Tier-1 rewrite + shadow-tree purge (blast radius too large — ~30 callsite migration). Plan ARIA-V3.2 lands Tier-1 unified-writer fix for D1, Tier-2 narrow caller-layer assertion for D2, Tier-3 schema completeness for D3, with 10 invariants total under aria-kernel/tests/invariants/v3_2/.

evidences.summary: D1 ROOT CAUSE — three independent writers to beliefs.jsonl; only _record_belief stamps verified_at + base_commit_sha. _apply_diff_to_existing_beliefs (diff-decay) + _mark_quarantined_source_beliefs (quarantine) append rows without refreshing freshness.

D2 ROOT CAUSE — tools_dir() default fallback Path('aria-tools') is CWD-relative. When invoked from aria-kernel/ subdir, creates SHADOW aria-kernel/aria-tools/ tree. Reflection's _gate_activity_summary then reads the shadow ledger (8 stale rows) instead of canonical aria-tools/governance.jsonl (29 fresh rows).
D3 ROOT CAUSE — append_tools_governance call for 'discovery_dirty_tree_skipped' omits cycle_id in details dict, despite cycle_id being in function scope and every sibling event including it.

Plan ARIA-V3.2 master plan — 6-agent audit (3 Explore + 3 Plan), 4 commits planned (D3 -> D2 -> D1 -> holistic), 10 invariants under aria-kernel/tests/invariants/v3_2/, F-010-D4 named-deferral to V3.3.
